Hello,

I saw your opening for a UI Designer at Monsoonfish and wanted to reach out, as your focus on clean execution and high-integrity craft really resonated with my background.

At Ascent Business Solutions, I currently build reusable design systems and digital creatives that cut turnaround time and streamline workflows. Previously at AT Creation, I worked on brand systems and UI design for early-stage teams.

You can see this approach in Bounceless, my B2B case study that demonstrates how I structure a clean verification experience and deliver high-fidelity interfaces: https://ananya-portfolio-nu.vercel.app/

I am currently based in Nagpur and am fully ready to relocate to Pune for this role. Would you be open to a quick look at that case study or a brief chat this week?

Ananya
